description: PB-63 is the Regional Transport Office for the Khadoor Sahib sub-division in the Tarn Taran district of Punjab. This office facilitates motor vehicle registration, issuance of driving licenses, and other transport-related services under the state transport department.
address: Sub-Divisional Magistrate Office, Tehsil Complex, Khadoor Sahib, District Tarn Taran, Punjab
